description: Candidate formats for a file, ranked: a signature match beats a MIME type, which beats an extension. Read the bytes yourself and pass them as hex; the file never leaves the machine: magic_hex = the first bytes (`xxd -p -l 1024 file`), tail_hex = the last bytes (`tail -c 512 file | xxd -p`) so end-of-file signatures can be checked, whole_file when magic_hex is the entire file. Full PRONOM signatures and their priorities decide between close formats (PNG 1.0 / 1.2 / APNG). Then call lookup_format on the best candidate.

extension.description: File name or extension, e.g. report.doc or .doc

magic_hex.description: First bytes of the file as hex, spaces allowed (1024 bytes recommended)

mime.description: MIME type if known, e.g. from `file --mime-type`

tail_hex.description: Last bytes of the file as hex (512 bytes recommended)

name: identify_file
title: Identify a file
